first_feedback_definition: First changed main Settings body for Settings/family/mode actions; visible Search rail change for Files→Search. Trusted pointerdown origin, separate visible start/end calibration; color/press cues in the excluded menu are not counted. Native onset and +50/+200/+500ms frames reviewed to verify action content and transition sequence.

observations: Normal Settings entrance and return retain the same fade sequence and final chapter/content.
Search reveals the same pane and fitted labels, without a different first-show fit or transient text at reviewed samples.

Friendly and Glass changes show the same destination content and existing optical completion sequence. Bake completion advances earlier in some optimized samples; no alternative optics or changed motion code was introduced.
Application reduce-animations shows settled content immediately in the sampled entrance frames for both artifacts.
review.limit: Sampled-frame visual review and DOM/fit assertions support parity; this is not a claim that every compressed pixel of every frame is bit-identical.

recorder_shutdown: gpu-browser stop exit1: Recorder did not stop gracefully and was killed; validated recovery clip retained if readable. Both action streams and both calibration sequences are present; independent complete decode passed. Exact owned browser/ffmpeg PID checks returned[] after stop.
